contract.label: Multi-select
contract.summary: Choosing several values at once: a trigger plus a searchable checkbox listbox with Select all and Clear. The one place a checkmark belongs. The tag-style selector on this page ships as a separate registry item.

parts.name: MultiSelect
parts.description: The composed control — trigger, search, checkbox list, and the Select all / Clear row.

props.name: surface
props.description: What the trigger sits on — default inside a card, sheet, dialog or table row, where it rests clear so the surface shows through; page straight on the shell's muted content area, where it rests and hovers like an outline Button so a filter row reads as one surface.

rules: **Pick the surface by what is underneath.** A trigger placed straight on the shell's `muted` content area — a filter row, a page-size select — takes `surface="page"`, which rests and hovers like an outline Button (`outline-surface`, `outline-hover`), so the row reads as one surface. Inside a `card`, `sheet`, `dialog` or table row it keeps `default`.
antiPatterns: A field on the muted page body given `bg-background`, `bg-card` or `bg-white` instead of `surface="page"` — in dark mode `background` is darker than `card`, so the field sinks below the cards beside it.
